title: The Sea Cucumber's Regrowing Brain
hook: Imagine if you could regrow your brain in a week.
script: Imagine if you could regrow your brain in a week. How does the sea cucumber achieve this marvel? Their nervous system ejects organs, including the brain, and regrows them. The Holothuria parvula species can lose 60% of its body mass and survive. They rely on a decentralized nerve net, not a central brain. This regrowth can even create a new body from a small piece. What if humans had this power?
